review.tagline: Rust AI agent with desktop app, CLI and API, extended through MCP
review.summary: goose is a general-purpose agent written in Rust that runs locally as a desktop app (macOS, Linux, Windows), a CLI, or an embeddable API. It connects to 15+ model providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Ollama, OpenRouter, Azure and Bedrock, and to 70+ extensions over the Model Context Protocol. It is hosted by the Agentic AI Foundation at the Linux Foundation.
review.audience: Developers wanting a local, provider-agnostic agent for code and automation
strengths: Desktop app, CLI and API from one Rust codebase
15+ providers, including Ollama for local models
Can use existing Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini subscriptions via ACP
70+ MCP extensions; custom distros with preset providers and branding
weaknesses: README gives no RAM, GPU or port requirements
CLI install is a curl-pipe-to-bash script
Scope is general-purpose, not focused solely on coding
README has no demo and little detail on the API
needs: Needs LLM provider API key or ACP-linked subscription
Models: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Ollama, OpenRouter
